from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors

rw=Chem.RWMol()
names={}
def atom(name,el='C'):
    a=Chem.Atom(el); idx=rw.AddAtom(a); names[name]=idx; return idx
# heavy atoms
for n in ['A','B','C','D','Dm','IPr','IpMe1','IpMe2','F','E','Em','N','U','R','S','T','H','Q','I','J','K','G','L','M','V','Oc','Oe']:
    atom(n, {'N':'N','Oc':'O','Oe':'O'}.get(n,'C'))
def bond(a,b,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(names[a],names[b],typ)
# cyclobutane and isopropyl
for a,b in [('A','B'),('B','C'),('C','D'),('D','A'),('D','F'),('D','Dm'),('A','IPr'),('IPr','IpMe1'),('IPr','IpMe2')]: bond(a,b)
# cage core
for a,b in [('F','E'),('F','G'),('F','L'),('E','N'),('E','R'),('E','Em'),('N','U'),('N','Q'),('U','R'),('R','S'),('S','T'),('T','H'),('H','Q'),('H','I'),('H','G'),('I','J'),('J','K'),('K','G'),('L','M'),('M','V'),('V','Oc'),('V','Oe'),('Oe','G')]: bond(a,b)
bond('V','Oc',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
print('Formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m), 'Heavy',m.GetNumAtoms())
# Add Hs and generate conformers
mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=34892; params.numThreads=0; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh,numConfs=100,params=params)
print('confs',len(cids))
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mh)
results=[]
for cid in cids:
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mh,props,confId=cid)
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
    results.append((ff.CalcEnergy(),cid))
results.sort()
print('min energies',results[:5])
energy,cid=results[0]
conf=mh.GetConformer(cid)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mh.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
    f.write(f'RDKit ETKDG/MMFF optimized structure; energy {energy:.3f} kcal/mol\n')
    for a in mh.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
